positions.subject: q:ai/data-center-moratorium
positions.summary: Supports a national data center moratorium until stronger protections exist for communities, utilities, and the environment.

positions.subject: q:civil-rights/lgbtq-nondiscrimination
positions.summary: Her campaign plan says she would prohibit discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing, education and public accommodations, and lists the Equality Act (H.R.15) among bills she would cosponsor.

positions.subject: q:technology/platform-self-preferencing
positions.summary: Her campaign plan lists the American Innovation and Choice Online Act (S.4746), described there as prohibiting large online platforms from self-preferencing, among bills she would cosponsor.
